Third-party libraries bundled with DeepPilot:
- SheetJS xlsx 0.18.5 (Apache-2.0)
- jsPDF 2.5.2 (MIT)
- jsPDF-AutoTable 3.8.4 (MIT)
- JSZip 3.10.1 (MIT)
- PDF.js 4.10.38 by Mozilla (Apache-2.0) — vendor/pdfjs, used to read the text of PDFs
- Geist & Geist Mono fonts by Vercel (SIL Open Font License 1.1) — see fonts/OFL-Geist.txt. fonts/Geist-PDF-*.ttf are static, Latin-subset instances of Geist used to embed the font in generated PDFs (same license).
- Icons adapted from Lucide (ISC License, https://lucide.dev)
